outcome: Helped Bikhai prepare for and complete his induction into the Companions.
citation: Objectives require finding armor and completing Bikhai's induction ceremony; s40 is an untexted [COMPLETE] terminal. RUNTIME-VERIFY which of s40 and s200 represents the successful induction.
branch_note: NEEDS-TAG: sponsor_companion_induction; the player assists another person's faction oath but does not swear it.

outcome: Helped Bikhai prepare for and complete his induction into the Companions.
citation: Objectives require finding armor and completing Bikhai's induction ceremony; s200 is a second untexted [COMPLETE] terminal. RUNTIME-VERIFY which of s40 and s200 represents the successful induction.
branch_note: NEEDS-TAG: sponsor_companion_induction; alternate positional terminal retained inert.

outcome: Gave Wikky his agreed share of the treasure-hunting reward after their expedition.
citation: s55/s60 journal says the reward is a lot of gold and directs the player to give Wikky his share; s100 [COMPLETE]: "I gave Wikky his share of the reward for helping to recover the treasure book."
branch_note: Fair division of payment for shared work; not charity.

outcome: Healed Ma'kara's life-threatening injuries after finding her beside the river.
citation: s10 journal: "Her injuries need to be healed before she succumbs to them." s15: "Her injuries were serious, but I managed to heal her."

outcome: Recovered Ma'kara's stolen belongings and honored her dead brother's final message by returning it to her.
citation: s55/s60 journal records Udasi-dro's death and his note to Ma'kara; s100 [COMPLETE] recaps healing Ma'kara, retrieving her belongings, finding her brother, and returning his dying note.
branch_note: Completion row excludes heal_comfort because the healing already has its own s15 milestone.

outcome: Recovered Bikhai's stolen personal locket and returned it to him.
citation: s70 journal records recovery from the thieves; s80 records returning it; s100 [COMPLETE]: "I helped Bikhai... recover a personal locket that was stolen from him."
branch_note: NEEDS-TAG: recover_stolen_keepsake; not lawful justice and Bikhai is not framed as vulnerable.

outcome: Recovered Mythic Dawn Commentaries Volume One and returned the proscribed text to Nanak.
citation: s10 journal identifies Mythic Dawn Commentaries Volume 1; s20 says it was found; s50 [COMPLETE] says the player returned it to Nanak.
branch_note: The sought text is Daedric cult literature; the act is acquisition of proscribed lore rather than generic scholarship.

outcome: Confronted and killed the armed thief Gatka-Dar at Traitor's Post.
citation: s20 journal sends the player to Gatka-Dar's former hideout; s30: "I have killed Gatka-Dar at Traitor's Post." The next stage retrieves the skeleton key from her.
branch_note: No record evidence of treachery or helplessness; treated as open combat.

outcome: Broke S'ariq out of jail after he said Gatka-Dar had framed him for murder.
citation: s50 journal records unlocking S'ariq's cell; s100 [COMPLETE] says the player helped him escape after Gatka-Dar framed him.
branch_note: NEEDS-TAG: free_wrongfully_imprisoned; the act is an extralegal rescue and does not cleanly equal uphold_law_justice.
